body: Today, the Calendar, the day modal and the note view/edit modal match the Claude Design mock-up, and the owner confirmed it on macOS: "The changes work as expected." and "All changes complete." Shipped as PRs 164 to 169, all merged; main is at 042c164. The full local gate on merged main was analyze clean with 1980 tests and 39 goldens, and 1982 tests and 41 goldens after the edit-glyph fix. All three criteria are met: spec approved, every Step gated and the merged result green, and the owner's check on macOS. Carried forward, not blocking: benchmark 5 is unrun on the compact cards and nothing was run on an Android device; the local gate does not run integration_test; the compact card's short-note text scaling works around NoteBody having no style parameter.
